title: GuppyLM: A ~9M parameter LLM that talks like a small fish

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Guppy LM is a 9 million parameter language model built from scratch that does exactly one thing. Pretends to be a small fish named Guppy. No swiggloo, no rope, just a pure vanilla six-layer transformer. Trains in 5 minutes on a free Collab T4 GPU. The entire pipeline is exposed. Data generation, BPE, tokenizer, training, architecture, training loop, inference. Ask it the meaning of life. It says food. The answer is always
